process.title: Birmingham funerals, inheritance and disposal of family assets
process.description: Operating as Adam Pleskot, Vincent spends the month in Birmingham arranging the parents’ funeral, handling inheritance formalities and selling family assets before leaving permanently.

participant.role: protagonist; Vincent operating as Adam Pleskot after the identity takeover

inputs.description: The parents’ deaths and Vincent’s assumption of Adam’s identity create the need and opportunity to settle family affairs.
The parents’ estate includes their house, a car and other valuable possessions to be disposed of.

steps.description: Arrange the parents’ funeral.
Handle the formalities connected with inheriting the parents’ wealth.
Sell the parents’ house, car and other valuable possessions; retain the money and remaining belongings for departure.

outcomes.description: The parents’ funeral has been arranged and inheritance formalities handled.
The house, car and other saleable valuables have been sold; Adam holds the resulting money and remaining belongings for his move.

process.title: Frankfurt stay, lottery win and preparation for New York
process.description: Adam stays in an apartment at the Leonardo Royal Hotel Frankfurt until his departure for New York. During the stay he wins LOTTO 6aus49 using foreknowledge and transfers the proceeds to his New York bank account.

participant.role: protagonist; Vincent operating as Adam Pleskot after the identity takeover

inputs.description: Adam’s permanent departure from Birmingham and arrival in Frankfurt establish this temporary stay.
Adam has money and remaining belongings from Birmingham, accommodation in Frankfurt, and knowledge of the lottery result.

steps.description: Stay in the Frankfurt hotel apartment until departure.
Enter LOTTO 6aus49 and match six winning numbers.
Collect the winnings and send the proceeds to the First National City Bank account in New York.
Leave Frankfurt by air for New York.

outcomes.description: The Frankfurt stay is complete and Adam departs for New York.
Lottery proceeds have been sent to Adam’s account at First National City Bank in New York.
